{{Quote|If we can get the Ansionians to commit to pulling out of the Republic, no one will really care. But because of their alliances, their withdrawal should be enough to sway their already vacillating partners in both the Malarian Alliance and the Keitumite Treaty to follow.|[[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]|<ref name="Approaching">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
'''Malari''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]]. It was the origin point of the [[Malarian]]s and was both a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a signatory of the [[Malarian Alliance]] treaty, the latter of which bound it to the planet [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of the Independent Systems]] sought to facilitate the secession of the Malarian Alliance from the Republic; however, the Separatist plans were foiled by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission to Ansion]], which resulted in the planet and the alliance remaining loyal to the Republic.

==Description==
Malari<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="Fry">{{Twitter|jasoncfry|status/294566730532024320|[[Jason Fry]]|archivefile=File:JasonFryAtlas.png}}</ref> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE" /> located in the [[Malari system/Legends|Malari system]], a part of the [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Assuming the internal divisions continue to widen, I would expect a formal vote on whether to withdraw from the Republic within half a standard year.''"<br />"''At which point we can look on with satisfaction as those who have been traditionally allied to Ansion follow suit, and those allied to the allies fall in turn.|Ansion's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mousul]] and Presidente Shu Mai|<ref name="Approaching" />}}
[[File:Ansion-TEA.jpg|thumb|The Malarian Alliance linked Malari to Ansion (pictured).]]
Malari was colonised by the natives of [[Mamendin]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />

By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">{{CSWECite|II|279|Malarian Alliance}} establishes that Malari was a part of both the [[Malarian Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Malari was linked to<ref name="CSWE" /> the Mid Rim planet [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]<ref name="TEA" /> both commercially and militarily via the [[Malarian Alliance]], a treaty<ref name="CSWE" /> that had been established at some point by approximately [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="33 BBY">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]'' establishes that the [[Malarian Alliance]] was in effect "eleven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]," which corresponds to approximately [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> By the former [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="22 BBY" /> Malari was also a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The Malarian Alliance placed Malari in a web of mutual affiliations with three [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]: the [[Mamendin system/Legends|Mamendin system]] and the Mid Rim's [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion]] and [[Dbari system/Legends|Dbari systems]]. In addition, Malari, its partner [[Star/Legends|star]] systems, and the [[Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty]]&mdash;also affiliated with both the Malari system and Ansion&mdash;all had treaties of their own with other worlds, which led to the seemingly insignificant Ansion lying at the center of a network of approximately forty [[Politics/Legends|politically]] connected systems. During the ongoing [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]],<ref name="TEA" /> signatory systems of both the Malarian Alliance and the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty were individually considering leaving the Republic.<ref name="Approaching" />

The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] intended to facilitate the secession of Ansion from the Republic, which was predicted by the Separatists to cause a cascade of secession by all the systems linked to the planet via its treaties, as well. However, a [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission to Ansion]] undertaken at the [[Time/Legends|time]] by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on behalf of the Republic resulted in that world<ref name="TEA" /> and its partners remaining loyal to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government,<ref name="Approaching" /> foiling the Separatist plans. At some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the newly appointed Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the Churnis [[Sector/Legends|sector]] declared all existing treaties and alliances involving Ansion to be null and void.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Malari was the origin world of the social group known as the [[Malarian]]s.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malari was first indirectly mentioned in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Malari system, and therefore the planet, in grid square I-6.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the star systems listed in the book's Appendix section are named after the most prominent planets or celestial bodies located in those systems. This article therefore considers the origin world of the Malarians to be named in accordance with the Malari system.<ref name="Fry" />
